article.hook: Someone says one thing but means another. The roads between words feel fogged in. Mercury in Pisces makes the mind wander into what’s felt, not said - but the signal gets fuzzy fast.
article.lived: Over the next few weeks, conversations drift into stories and images instead of facts. We lean on intuition, piecing together meaning from tone and gesture. Thought slides sideways - a dream remembered, a feeling caught midair - and we work harder to translate it back into language that holds. You notice how long it takes to pin down what really landed, if it ever does.
article.turn: The gift is hearing beyond words until you drown in everything unsaid. We gloss over details, lose track of who said what, or avoid the hard point because the mood feels too fragile. Silence becomes a shield and a trap. Speak the line that breaks the haze or settle for misunderstanding as the default.
